entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the appellant states upon instructions that the appellant has undergone the entire sentence awarded to him, however, he intends to press the present appeal on merits.

2. Considering that the matter relates to the offence under Section 376 IPC, the IO shall inform the complainant about her right to free legal aid/representation in accordance with the decision of the Supreme Court in Jagjeet Singh v. Ashish Mishra, reported as (2022) 9 SCC 321 and if required,
shall assist the prosecutrix in approaching the Member Secretary, Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee who may appoint a panel counsel, if so requested.

sentences.text: IO shall also supply copy of the appeal paper book to the prosecutrix as well as to the counsel, if so appointed.
In the meantime, a report be also requisitioned from the Member Secretary, Delhi State Legal Services Authority, Rouse Avenue Courts
